C2_policy: Published replacement-cost stress is retained in COST_STRESS_REFERENCES.csv; same fills are not new independent observations or new strategy configurations
PF_units: Per instrument C1 price PF and raw initial-risk R PF separately; no mixed-instrument price PF

aggregation_numeric_precision.reason: Saved Decimal28 ratios carry final-digit rounding; this reporting tolerance is not a trade/PnL or eligibility adjustment

authorization: Registry preparation only; no Optimization authorized or executed
before_each_individual_optimization: Freeze exact parameters, source, entry/execution/Stop/Take conventions
Freeze candidate IDs and evaluation rules before P&L
calendar_definition: Distinct MSK entry dates/months among resolved known CLOSED, never source-coverage days or signal days; positive/negative months use saved closure dates and after-C1 R

goals.Take_R_definition: Explicitly freeze gross/raw-risk/net-net denominator for each individual study; do not silently change old target conventions
goals.concentration: no excessive single-trade/month dependence; bounds frozen before each individual study
goals.drawdown: controlled; quantitative bound frozen before each individual study

historical_reference_policy: Recorded archive audit is not present acceptance/verification of a historical configuration; NEEDS_VERIFICATION until separately confirmed, never discard positive summaries
missing_value: NOT_AVAILABLE with field-specific reason; never missing-as-zero
queue_rule: A then B then C then other eligible families in documented working order; never max historical PF
unknown_policy: Immutable historical UNKNOWN; report exclusions/skips separately; conditional known economics do not establish annual profitability
